Woman receives house arrest after dogs kill 11-year-old boy

An Edmonton woman has been sentenced to house arrest after her dogs killed an 11-year-old boy named Kache Grist. The sentencing hearing included the victim's father speaking about the incident. The specific terms of the community sentence, including house arrest, were handed down by the court. The exact breed of the dogs was not specified in the coverage.
